notes: Planning-only proposal. No implementation, source edits, br/git mutations, upstream submission, merge or release is authorized by this artifact.

Coverage uses the union of runtime-ssr violation identities and runtime-ssr import-edge sources: 33 unique files, each assigned once. All five import sources already occur among the 33 violations; there are zero additional import-only identities in this lane. Counts: composition 9, streaming 8, request lifecycle 3, render/RSC 13.

All four route audits can start immediately and independently. Write readiness is per shard and per real consumed seam, not a blanket lane-wide ownership-contract completion barrier. Shared helper/API contracts create targeted handoffs; final combined runtime acceptance still follows integration.

Recorded cumulative excess is not the eventual PR delta and does not grant an extra budget. The audited mainline base is eded841256a7cffdaa622e3889fc83407debd3e4; include PR49 and later edits in the eventual merge range. Retain the 20 added-plus-removed line hard cap and non-shrink ledger obligations for every audited identity, including tests and configuration.

This is a natural four-worker split, not a Node-versus-workerd split or a source-versus-tests split. Platform streaming behavior is tightly coupled; render artifact identity is tightly coupled to its entrypoints and build configuration. Independent request lifecycle work does not require either rendering implementation to finish.

After lawful extraction, package manifests, exports, lockfile, ledger, boundary allowance records and package cohort remain single-owner integration handoffs. New destinations are not implicit write permission; allocate exact files without overlapping existing runtime-extensions ownership.

Preserve Node and native workerd streaming, hydration, early-script order, runtime and complete delivery-unit identity, RSC boundaries, public assets and federation composition. No app shims, wrappers, generated edits, alias hiding, allowance resets or synthetic green tests.

Program acceptance still requires source then published-byte ERP and Tractor checks with visible Tractor UI preserved. Shared-port downstream runs remain serial unless actual supported isolated environments are available; this module split does not invent host-level runtime isolation.
